subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` with hostname fallback, or should instance identity wait for the standard/resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The branch introduces a new env/default identity contract and collector-visible host-derived value, which automation cannot safely bless without maintainer intent.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env var and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through the standard OTel resource path or an approved OpenClaw runtime identity seam.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` intentionally, but require docs, precedence rules, privacy guidance, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused while the open resource-identity issue settles the stable identity source and exported-resource acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env var and hostname fallback, then implement `service.instance.id` through the standard OTel resource path or an approved OpenClaw runtime identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: `bek91` owns the canonical identity issue and has adjacent diagnostics-otel trace history, so they are the best routing candidate for the product/API decision.
